question: I bought wireless headphones 20 days ago and the left side stopped working. Can I still return them for a refund?

passages.text: You can return most items within 14 days of delivery for a full refund. After 14 days, returns are not accepted, but faulty items may still be covered by the warranty.
Electronics carry a 12-month limited warranty against manufacturing defects. A warranty claim gets you a repair or a replacement, not a refund.
